name: What is the typical timeline for a roof replacement project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a roof replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for a roof replacement can vary depending on the roof's size, complexity, and weather conditions. For an average residential home, the removal of the old roof and installation of a new one usually takes 1-3 days. This does not include the time for material ordering and delivery, or any necessary permits. We aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: An average residential roof replacement typically takes 1-3 days for installation, not including material delivery or permits. This timeline can vary by roof size and complexity.
